blogPosts.title: Switchboard Upgrades for Older Homes in Boronia
blogPosts.excerpt: Why upgrading your switchboard is crucial for safety in older Boronia properties and how Tri Ct Electr ensures compliance with current standards.
body: Many homes in Boronia, especially those built decades ago, have outdated switchboards that pose significant safety risks. Old ceramic fuses and inadequate wiring can lead to electrical fires, especially with modern appliance loads. Upgrading to a switchboard with circuit breakers and safety switches is essential for protecting your family and property in compliance with Australian standards.

Tri Ct Electr specialises in switchboard upgrades for Boronia homes, assessing your current setup to recommend the best solution. A typical upgrade costs between $800 and $2,000, depending on complexity, but it prevents hazards like overloaded circuits. We ensure all work meets AS/NZS 3000 wiring rules, providing peace of mind for Boronia homeowners.

Boronia's older housing stock, with weatherboard designs common in Melbourne's east, often has switchboards that haven't been updated for decades. This increases risks during peak usage times, like hot summers when air conditioners strain the system. Upgrading includes adding RCDs (residual current devices) for added protection, a must for modern safety.

The process for a switchboard upgrade in Boronia involves a free assessment by Tri Ct Electr, followed by installation that typically takes a few hours. We handle all council approvals if needed and test the system thoroughly to ensure reliability. Upgrades also future-proof your home for electric vehicle charging or solar integration.

For Boronia residents, the benefits extend beyond safety: an upgraded switchboard can lower insurance premiums and increase property value. Many insurance companies in Victoria require modern electrical systems, so staying compliant is crucial. Tri Ct Electr provides certificates of compliance after every upgrade, recognised by authorities and insurers.

In summary, switchboard upgrades are a critical investment for older Boronia homes to ensure safety and modernity. Contact Tri Ct Electr for a free quote and let our experts safeguard your property with professional, code-compliant work.
